SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT. All people and places are fictional. Not a legal record.
INDENTURE OF SALE
This Indenture dated the 21st day of January, 2021 is entered into by Dr. Vikram Sethi, son of
Harpal Sethi, of 14 Ring Road, Harinagar, the party of the first part (hereinafter the Transferor),
and Ms. Neha Kulkarni, daughter of Anil Kulkarni, of 6 Hill View, Harinagar (hereinafter the
Transferee).
The Transferor became owner by way of a registered deed of conveyance dated 3 March 2011
from Latika Sethi.
For a price of INR 62,75,000 the Transferor hereby transfers all that piece of land, R.S. No.
402/1, Khata No. 56, admeasuring 0.08 hectare, in Sunrise Colony, Harinagar.
East - Service lane; West - House of A. Rao; North - Open plot; South - Nala.
Registered with the Sub-Registrar, Sunrise on 25/01/2021 as Document No. 1190/2021. Stamp
duty Rs. 4,39,000 paid.
